definitions.explanation: A firm, gelatinous food made from the root of the konjac plant (devil's tongue), with a chewy texture and virtually no calories.

examples.japanese: おでんにはこんにゃくが{入|はい}っている。
こんにゃくはカロリーがほとんどない。
{煮物|にもの}に{入|い}れるこんにゃくは{味|あじ}が{染|し}み{込|こ}みやすい。
examples.english: Konnyaku in simmered dishes absorbs flavors easily.

notes:
Also written as {蒟蒻|こんにゃく} (rare). Forms include:
- {板|いた}こんにゃく (block form)
- {糸|いと}こんにゃく/しらたき (noodle form)
- {玉|たま}こんにゃく (ball form)

Popular as a diet food due to being mostly water and fiber. Often scored with a knife ({隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}) to help absorb flavors. Common in:
- おでん
- {煮物|にもの}
- {炒|いた}め{物|もの}
- すき{焼|や}き (as しらたき)

Also used to make こんにゃくゼリー (konjac jelly snacks).
